title: E1BenchmarkMetrics
description: Schema for benchmark performance results output by E1.

record_count.description: Total number of network events in the benchmark dataset

worker_count.description: Number of concurrent worker threads used for multithreaded run

sequential_duration_ms.description: Median execution duration in milliseconds for sequential processing

multithreaded_duration_ms.description: Median execution duration in milliseconds for multithreaded processing

sequential_throughput.description: Sequential throughput in records per second

multithreaded_throughput.description: Multithreaded throughput in records per second

sequential_observed_heap_bytes.description: Sequential observed JVM heap memory occupancy in bytes

multithreaded_observed_heap_bytes.description: Multithreaded observed JVM heap memory occupancy in bytes

output_parity.description: True if sequential and multithreaded outputs are 100% identical and in deterministic order
